claims.text: Some Orphans drift from Tradition to Tradition looking for a philosophy that makes sense, and they seldom find one.
Many Orphans settle among the Hollow Ones, whose looser philosophy gives most of the gains of joining a Tradition.

title: The Crafts
summary: Small mage groups outside the Nine Traditions.

claims.text: Smaller groups, called Crafts or Cliques, keep growing: among them the Children of Proteus, the Bata'a, the Sisters of Hippolyta, the Sculptors of Fate, the Children of Knowledge and the Fringe Walkers.
The Children of Knowledge say no Tradition is older than theirs.

title: Hollow Ones Beliefs
summary: What the Hollow Ones hold, by their own account.

claims.text: Hollow Ones rarely discuss their shared beliefs with other mages, and many deny that Ascension is real.
Their magic mirrors the occult as mass media portrays it, and some of them work without foci at all.
They feel an emptiness inside that nothing fills, and they want to learn for themselves what truth lies behind the legends of vampires and werewolves.
Their punk bars and dance halls have become something like modern opium dens.
